rules.expected: Each named pair has candidate-specific validation and multiple-orientation coverage in complete outcomes, or truthful attempted coverage in bounded failure.
Candidate component energies support the common E_complex minus E_ion minus E_PC equation and declared sign convention.
Complete outcomes place DED2_PC stronger-binding than TEA_PC with sensitivity consistency; bounded failure is judged on honest coverage.
The conclusion conditionally supports competitive association within isolated-pair scope and does not claim condensed-phase proof.
The report distinguishes isolated electronic binding from bulk free energy, coordination populations and electrode behavior.
